note: Converted from the legacy personal-corpus scripts/routing-corpus.json (positives/negatives) during the measure/markdown-render/knowledge-docs fold-in, 2026-07-07. Routing corpus for vision-memo-author. Positives span the four archetypes (manifesto / reframe / case-for / synthesis) plus the 'crystallize accumulated thinking' entry (harvested from the legacy evals.json), and — added 2026-07-04 post deep-review — symptom/diagnostic and improve-phrased asks (M2 wants imperative/diagnostic/symptom/indirect coverage, not imperative-only), since this is an -author skill whose verb contract includes the evaluate/improve loop. Negatives are the fenced siblings: what-to-build documents (prd-/spec-/lld-/adr-author, reference-author) and the non-argument genres the craft doc backs off from (marketing, tutorial, status/report, neutral balanced analysis), PLUS the review-intent boundary negative ('review this vision memo against its rubric' → doc-reviewer independently critiques; this seat authors and self-evaluates — the maker≠critic split). The thesis-missing case (legacy eval #5, 'write about why documentation is important') is a BEHAVIOR test, not a routing case — the skill routes here but then asks for a thesis before drafting; see SKILL.md Step 2.
